title: Structural Redundancy in Subspace Network Coding via Atomic Decompositions
summary: Random linear network coding (RLNC) provides a powerful framework for non-coherent communication, where reliable transmission requires correcting errors and erasures induced by network mixing and motivates the use of subspace codes. In this work, we introduce an atomic perspective on subspace coding by formalizing the notion of minimal atomic decompositions in the lattice L(V ) of subspaces of a finite-dimensional vector space over a finite field. We study the function N that assigns to each subspace the number of its minimal atomic decompositions and establish its key structural properties.…
